title: DojoLiq Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Transport yourself to warmer climates with Vaporesso DojoLiq Pineapple Ice. The inhale delivers the bold, tangy-sweet taste of fresh, juicy Pineapple, offering a rich and authentic tropical profile. To keep the flavour crisp and invigorating, a smooth wave of frosty Ice sweeps through on the exhale, perfectly chilling the fruit notes for a highly refreshing all-day vape. This Nicotine Salt e-liquid is mixed to an exact 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, a bespoke split chosen to maximise the specific flavour saturation and wicking speed for this recipe. The result is a crystal-clear taste profile suitable for any MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kit. Available in 5mg,10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers a smooth draw and efficient nicotine delivery. Created by industry leaders Vaporesso, the DojoLiq range translates the richly formulated, vivid flavours of their famous Dojo devices into a premium bottled e-liquid. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths to find the perfect level of satisfaction for your everyday vaping needs.
